correctness.rationale: The 12-vertex icosahedron with 30 edges and 20 triangular faces gives 60 oriented-edge truncation vertices and 90 edges. Every distance-two Rips shortcut is homotopic to a two-step graph walk. Its 12 pentagonal face boundaries lie in 4-simplices; each of its 20 hexagons has an explicit four-triangle filling, so the Rips complex is simply connected by planar facial generation. Exact exhaustive simplex counts are (60,270,340,120,12), Euler characteristic 22. The inspected check.py has a genuine maintained free-coface dictionary and a 120-step pairwise codimension-one elementary collapse, removing all simplices of dimension greater than 2 and leaving face counts (60,270,232). Consequently H2 is free of rank 21 (subgroup of free C2), and Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead give the integral wedge. Independently reconstructed all 60 vertices, 90 edges, 20 icosahedral faces, every Rips face and Euler 22; the 120-collapse proof is justified by inspected exact verifier, not claimed independently rerun.
